name: Benahadux (Spain)
description: Green field divided by a white Y-shaped pall issuing from the hoist, the red triangle at the hoist charged with the crowned municipal arms of Benahadux (a leaf on yellow, a white bar on green and a wheel).
history: The flag was approved by decree 291/2001 of 26 December (BOJA no. 17 of 9 February 2002) as a rectangular silk or taffeta flag of 1,500 by 1,000 millimetres, its field divided into three parts by a white Y, with the complete arms of the locality centred on the red field; the arms had been approved by decree 142/1994 of 12 July 1994.
